basic_info.description:
Features of this unique penthouse condo on the north slope of Russian Hill: 
- Breathtaking views of the City, Bay, & Alcatraz 
- Private roof deck with BBQ, lounge area, fire pits, glass railings, and lighting 
- Elevator opens directly into unit 
- Direct street access as well 
- Down-to-studs renovation 5 years ago 
- Air conditioning 
- Open floor plan 
- Kitchen with massive island, state of the art appliances, designer tiles, shelves, cabinetry and lighting 
- Custom stone wall, gas fireplace, and sound system 
- Primary bedroom with massive closet, classic bay windows and double doors to an XL ensuite bathroom, which currently doubles as a gym 
- Guest bedroom with dual closets and barn door entry into spa like ensuite bathroom 
- Skylights throughout 
- High ceilings 
- Abundance of natural light 
- 2 car tandem garage parking is included 
- Storage shelves in garage are included 

Lease Terms: 
- Furnished or unfurnished 
- 12 month lease 
- Water and trash are included 
- Pets considered on a case by case basis 
- Square footage is approximate 
- Non-smoking unit 

SF City Rents
DRE# 02187202 (please don't use the DRE# to request a showing; instead provide the property address: 904 Filbert St.) 

This unit is a rental unit subject to the San Francisco Rent Ordinance, which limits evictions without just cause, and which states that any waiver by a tenant of their rights under the Rent Ordinance is void as contrary to public policy. This unit is not subject to rent increase restrictions. 

All data is obtained from various sources and is deemed to be true and accurate but is not guaranteed.
